insights: Extreme vertical rhythm with 5-10rem (20-40 spacing units) between major sections creates luxurious breathing room and forces focus on one idea at a time.
Centered-symmetric composition throughout—headlines, CTAs, and content blocks all align to a central vertical axis, reinforcing brand clarity and calm.
Minimal component vocabulary: pill buttons (white or black), elevated cards with subtle shadows, and full-bleed imagery. Only three primary UI elements repeated across the entire page.
Dark hero with inverted navigation (white text, mix-blend-difference) transitions seamlessly to light sections below, using color inversion rather than borders to mark the shift.
